title: Scenario
description: SPECIFICATION.md R-APP-1, R-APP-10 (DECISIONS D-027): a scenario as the flat map of its canonical text — one key=value line per entry, keys sorted, defaults included. A replay carries the keys of a replay, a scenario run those of a scenario run; unknown keys are rejected and every value is range-checked on import. Preset and class names are checked against presets.json.

v.description: version of this contract: 2 added the borders' keys (M5), 3 the scenario shown and the plant's contract (D-036); an older text opens with them at their defaults

scenario.description: scenario run: the scenario shown of the four of 2035 (D-036, D-058)

smr.clause.description: scenario run: the contract's negative-price clause (R-SMR-3, R-SMR-4)

profile.description: scenario run: the boundary profile of R-BND-5 (Distributed Energy, Global Ambition, National Trends of TYNDP 2024; National Trends+ of TYNDP 2026; REAL: the neighbours' observed prices of profile_year, D-051; TIGHT, TIGHTJ: the neighbours tight, each on its own or all at once, from energiamudel's research on Finland, Sweden and Poland, D-121)

profile_year.description: scenario run: the target year of the boundary profile when it is not the run's own (D-046); absent = the run's target year

neighbours.fuel.description: scenario run, optional, read and ignored since D-194: the neighbours' profiles are taken as published. Until then (D-072) published: the market model's own gas and CO2 prices behind the profile; scenario: a TYNDP 2024 Distributed Energy or Global Ambition profile re-priced to the scenario's

fuel.description: scenario run: the fuel and CO2 path (R-SUP-8)

price.gas.description: scenario run (D-064): the gas price, €/MWh thermal; absent = the fuel path's

price.eua.description: scenario run (D-064): the CO2 price, €/t; absent = the fuel path's

dsr.description: scenario run: the DSR preset, or none (R-DEM-6)

FI.level.description: R-BND-5 level factor; up to 3 since D-194, where the owner's 120 €/MWh for Poland is ×2.10 on its profile as published

FI.slope.description: R-BND-6: €/MWh per GW of net Finnish export; 0 = price-taker

battery.hours.description: R-STO-1, where a preset gives no energy

reserves.description: R-STO-5: upward reserve held out of the day-ahead market

links.profile.description: scenario run: the HVDC cables at their typical availability or at nameplate (R-LINK-3)

links.plan.description: scenario run: LT-PL held to Litgrid's plan 2026–2035 (R-LINK-3)

links.reserve.EE-LV.description: scenario run: MW held for balancing on EE-LV (R-LINK-5)

links.reserve.LV-LT.description: scenario run: MW held for balancing on LV-LT (R-LINK-5)

^(EE|LV|LT)\\.demand$.description: scenario run: the demand preset (R-DEM-1), or own (TYNDP 2026)

^(EE|LV|LT)\\.part\\.[a-z0-9_]+$.description: scenario run, optional (D-059): MW of a row of the fleet preset's source where two or more rows make one class; the class's MW is their sum; absent = the preset's rows in proportion

^(EE|LV|LT)\\.mw\\.[a-z0-9_]+$.description: scenario run: MW of a class of R-SUP-1

^bid\\.(EE|LV|LT)\\.[a-z0-9_]+$.description: scenario run, optional (D-090): EUR/MWh added to a thermal class's bid as its fuel, CO2 and running costs make it, gas aside; the panel sets it from the bid typed; absent = 0

^bid\\.gas$.description: scenario run, optional (D-164): EUR/MWh added to the gas plants' one bid of the three zones, a combined-cycle plant's cost plus the fitted adder; the panel sets it from the bid typed; absent = 0

^line\\.[a-z0-9_]+\\.on$.description: scenario run: a planned line in service (R-LINK-1)

^line\\.[a-z0-9_]+\\.whatif$.description: a line held at most at MW from one day to another, both included: none, or MW@MM-DD..MM-DD (R-LINK-4)
